messages:
Maya (Security): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on partner readiness for SOC2/ISO. We promised a concrete partner onboarding checklist + evidence flow.

Arjun (CTO): Agree. We should split by capability: network (VPC peering/privatelink), key management (BYOK/KMS), audit logs (export/format/retention), and shared-control attestations.

Maya (Security): Also need a clear statement on what Redwood will attest to vs what partners must provide.

Lena (Compliance): Minimum artifacts: system architecture diagram, control owner list, sample access review, key rotation proof, and signed attestation for shared controls. For ISO, include key lifecycle and crypto algorithm details.

Ivy (Infra): For logs we can produce daily JSONL exports to partner buckets. Proposed filename: partners/<partner-id>/audit-YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Each line: ts, request_id, principal, action, resource, success. I'll draft schema.

Kai (Solutions): I'll draft a partner README with onboarding steps, examples for requesting BYOK, and a troubleshooting FAQ. ETA 10 business days.

Maya (Security): Who owns the BYOK acceptance criteria? We need policy checks, CloudKMS access bindings, and logging enabled. Decide HSM vs software key guidance.

Arjun (CTO): Product to propose acceptance criteria. Also run a pilot with one partner to validate the flow.

Lena (Compliance): Add: sample support transcripts and incident ticket examples may be requested during SOC2 testing. Add to artifacts list.

calendar-bot: "Partner Onboarding Office Hours" weekly starting 2024-10-16, Thursdays 10:00-10:30 PT. Invites sent.

Maya (Security): Action owners: Kai (README + checklist) due 2024-10-28; Ivy (log export spec + example) due 2024-10-20; Arjun/Product (BYOK acceptance criteria) due 2024-10-18; Lena (artifact checklist for SOC2/ISO) due 2024-10-22. Please confirm.

Arjun (CTO): Confirmed. Maya will coordinate the first pilot.

Maya (Security): I'll create the doc at go/internal/partner-evidence and post link when ready. Thanks everyone.
